measurement.name: West Spitsbergen Current
measurement.standard_deviation_interpretation: Author-reported western-boundary variability of the selected core-width estimate; not confidence limits, physical-boundary error, annual extrema or seasonal range.
measurement.geographic_scope: Local WSC core at the 77.25 N glider target transect west of Svalbard; selected high-transport sections, not the entire WSC system.
measurement.section_orientation: Zonal target section; northward geostrophic component is section-normal. No flow-vector correction or geographic width-edge pair extracted.
measurement.layer: Vertically integrated Q across the sampled water column, independent of water-mass classification; gliders sample to 1000 m or above local seabed. Not a fixed-depth width.
measurement.time_convention: Table 1 target-section windows across three missions; discontinuous occupations, primarily autumn/winter. Individual width-selection membership unextracted.
measurement.boundary_rule: Published selected-core transport threshold operator; Q maxima east of x=275 km and section selection above their 60th percentile. Exact numerical threshold and selected count unextracted.
measurement.source_citation: Dundas, V. and Fer, I. (2026), Atlantic Water flow through Fram Strait to the Arctic Ocean measured by repeated glider transects, Ocean Science 22, 1003-1021, doi:10.5194/os-22-1003-2026.
measurement.source_locator: Section 3.1, printed p.1008 (PDF page 6), right column; methods sections 2.1-2.5, pp.1005-1008; Table 1 p.1006.
measurement.extraction_method: Published point and standard deviation transcribed after visual PDF inspection; no per-section reconstruction or boundary digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Rounded source statistic for selected sections. Objective mapping and satellite reference are method components; not direct edge observations or independent seasonal coverage.
remaining_gates: Recover the authors exact selection, estimator, per-section widths and geographical edges for reproducibility and physical map bands.
Obtain comparable observations across missing seasons before annual extrema or seasonal geometry.
measurement.range_interpretation: No width range is admitted. The separately reported 7 km standard deviation describes western-boundary variability, not minimum/maximum, confidence limits, measurement error or annual extrema.
